top_news.title: Large-Scale ChatBot Validation Through Customer Digital Twin Simulations
top_news.dek: Researchers propose using synthetic customer agents as digital twins to validate LLM-based chatbots at scale.
top_news.brief: The methodology uses high-fidelity synthetic customer agents (SCAs) grounded in real transactional data to simulate interactions. This approach aims to provide a cost-effective and scalable way to test chatbot performance and safety in regulated environments like banking.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the flow from real data to synthetic customer agent digital twins

top_news.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration
top_news.dek: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics ER 2, a model designed to improve spatial reasoning, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration.
top_news.brief: Gemini Robotics ER 2 aims to move beyond simple spatial awareness by enabling robots to handle complex task timing and multi-agent coordination. The system is designed to help robots operate more effectively in dynamic, real-world environments by integrating video understanding with physical action planning.
top_news.image_alt: Two robots, Duo and Apollo, working in a shared environment.

top_news.title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots
top_news.dek: Gemini Robotics 2 focuses on whole-body intelligence to improve robotic control, dexterity, and cross-platform skill transfer.
top_news.brief: This update addresses the limitations of traditional pre-programmed or teleoperated robots by enabling autonomous learning and adaptation. The focus is on whole-body control, allowing robots to perform complex tasks with greater dexterity and facilitating the transfer of learned skills across different hardware embodiments.
top_news.image_alt: Robotic arm and body performing a complex manipulation task.

top_news.title: NVIDIA Exemplar Cloud: Lessons for Unlocking Full Performance on AI Infrastructure
top_news.dek: NVIDIA identifies configuration gaps in kernel, BIOS, and NCCL settings as primary causes for performance variance in AI clusters.
top_news.brief: NVIDIA reports that identical hardware clusters often show 8-12% throughput differences due to cumulative configuration choices. Optimizing the software stack—specifically hypervisor, BIOS, and NCCL settings—is critical to reaching the 95% performance threshold required for NVIDIA Exemplar Cloud status.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing performance optimization layers in AI infrastructure.

top_news.title: Chrome Needs Twice-a-Week Patching Thanks to AI Bug Hunting
top_news.dek: Google is increasing Chrome's patching frequency to twice weekly due to the rise of AI-assisted vulnerability discovery.
top_news.brief: The use of AI tools to identify software vulnerabilities has significantly accelerated the discovery of bugs in Chrome. Consequently, Google has shifted to a more aggressive update schedule to address these security flaws as they are identified by automated systems.
top_news.image_alt: Chrome browser logo with a security shield icon.
